nodes.label: ai_readonly Postgres role + restricted views
nodes.rationale: Even a validation bug cannot expose more than the view layer allows; donor/ngo roles see PII-stripped views.

nodes.label: API runs queries as authenticated role with request.jwt.claims
nodes.norm_label: api runs queries as authenticated role with request.jwt.claims
nodes.rationale: app_api login role has no table privileges, so a query skipping the claims step fails instead of bypassing RLS.

nodes.label: Firebase to Supabase Third-Party Auth
nodes.rationale: Supabase RLS needs a verifiable JWT; trusting Firebase JWKS avoids a custom token-minting service and shared signing secret. Role/ngo_id carried as Firebase custom claims.
